digest.component_or_area: CI test execution / pytest timeout configuration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was reduced from 300s to 20s in story 73b8, causing xdist workers to crash on legitimate whole-tree-scan tests that require 18.7-29.93s of call time, particularly under coverage instrumentation.

The timeout_method=thread setting executes os._exit(1) on expiry, killing xdist workers outright without reporting a Failed: Timeout verdict, so worker crashes are invisible to normal timeout detection mechanisms.

A config-only fix to pyproject.toml timeout is ineffective on its own Verified gate run because GitHub resolves reusable workflows from trusted-main commit, where the stale CLI --timeout=20 flag overrides the patchset's ini change due to pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI.

Restoring timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml ini and _build-and-test.yml explicit flags, with headroom >= 2x the measured worst case (59.86s) and <= 600s guard, eliminates worker crashes on post-merge main.
When a worker dies under --dist loadgroup, pending items are re-dispatched to respawned workers that die on the same item until restart cap is reached, burning toward the 60-minute job ceiling.

The pytest-timeout precedence marker > CLI > env > ini means a conftest hook applying ini budget as markers to unmarked tests can make the ini authoritative even under stale CLI flags in future preventive changes.
